study: Summit specification-guided vs code-only unit test generation
specification_provenance: Original user stories and Product Backlog; specific deployment clarification from project team

requirements.text: A user can create and publish a post containing content.
requirements.evidence: Sprint 1 user story: create and publish a post; Product Backlog: title, description, category.

requirements.text: A user can create a post within a selected community.
requirements.evidence: Sprint 3 user story: new post is saved under the selected community.

requirements.text: A post may be published anonymously so the author identity is not shown to other users.
requirements.evidence: Product Backlog: anonymous posting; Sprint 3 anonymous-post user story. Note: identity hiding is an end-to-end requirement, not guaranteed testable solely in this service.

evaluation_notes: Anon identity hiding may require testing outside createPostService; service-level requirements coverage must be mapped to observable service behavior.
